lessons:
The beginning of wisdom|The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge. Wisdom starts not with knowing much, but with whom you fear and live before. (Prov 1:7)
Guard your heart|Above all else, guard your heart, for everything you do flows from it. (Prov 4:23)
The small choices of a day|From the scales in the market to a friend's house, wisdom lives in small daily choices. The LORD detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him. (Prov 11:1)
gospelBridge: Proverbs pictures Wisdom calling at the city gate. The New Testament says that this wisdom became a person and came to us. Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God. (1 Cor 1:24)
blessing:
Trust in the LORD with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight. (Prov 3:5–6)
May the Wisdom that called at the city gate keep your day, from morning until night.
invite:
If the story of God you met on this road has stayed with you, come and meet Jesus, who stands at the center of that story. Walk 'The Footsteps of Jesus' from the beginning, and visit a church near you. May you meet God in worship and in his word, be adopted as his child, and know the joy of calling God 'Father.' (Rom 8:15)
He is still standing at the door, waiting for you. (Rev 3:20)
